topics.title: OpenAI's Astra Solves 10 Decades-Old Math Problems for $2,000
topics.why: OpenAI's unreleased Astra model formally settled ten long-standing open problems in math and theoretical computer science, with full proof certificates, for about $2,000 in compute -- a preview of the reasoning power headed for every knowledge worker's toolkit.

topics.title: AI Chipmaker Etched Doubles to $21B in a Month
topics.why: Etched's valuation doubled to $21 billion after quant trading firm Jane Street tested its inference chip, bought a rack, and led a $700M round -- a sign investors think the next AI bottleneck is hardware, not models.

topics.title: YC AI Startup Offered Tattoos for Job Interviews
topics.why: LemonLime, a Y Combinator-backed AI startup, promised guaranteed interviews to anyone who got its logo tattooed on the spot -- seven people did before the backlash forced a public apology, a cautionary tale in how far AI-hype hiring stunts can go.
